test_pybind11_class_repr: test that pybind11 class types produce correct repr output with pybind11_type and class name
test_pybind11_class_inheritance: test pybind11 class inheritance by creating Pet, Dog, and Rabbit instances and verifying polymorphic method calls
test_pybind11_automatic_upcasting: test automatic upcasting of derived classes to base class types in pybind11 return values
test_pybind11_class_docstrings: test that pybind11 bound classes and methods have correct docstrings with type annotations
test_pybind11_class_refcount: test that pybind11 class instances correctly manage Python reference counts during creation and deletion
